**Cloak remembers your settings.** The theme and the "Auto-lock drives when
the computer sleeps" switch are now kept between runs instead of resetting
to System and on every time the app starts.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `cloak-v0.2.1-windows-x64.zip` | [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev) (`winget install WinFsp.WinFsp`) |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `cloak-v0.2.1-macos-arm64.zip` | [macFUSE](https://macfuse.github.io) |

**Windows:** unzip and run `Cloak\Cloak.exe`. Keep the folder together: the
engine (`cloak.exe`, `cloak-winmount.exe`) is in `Cloak\bin`.

**macOS:** unzip and drag `Cloak.app` to Applications. It isn't notarized,
so clear the download quarantine before first opening it:
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cloak.app`.

## What's new

- **Settings are saved** to `~/.cloak/settings.json` as soon as you change
  them, and applied when the app starts. A theme chosen in an earlier
  version carries over.

## Known limitations

- **The macOS app has not yet been tested on a real Mac.** Treat it as a
  preview and keep a backup of anything you put in a drive.
- Auto-lock runs on sleep, not when the screen locks.
- The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run
  (More info → Run anyway).
- FUSE-T is not supported yet (macFUSE only).
- The middle of every file stays plaintext on disk by design.
